scientific_question: Does key-Hadamard improve the propagation stability of recurrent-state INT8 error despite worse instantaneous local/output error?
source_panel: The 60 frozen AIME26 FP token trajectories used in QWEN_PERSISTENT_FUNCTIONAL_SURROGATE_V1; clean59 excludes only (aime26_28, seed 2) by the pre-existing symmetric numerical-validity rule.

observation.tokens: Frozen generated token IDs, positions t=0..N-2, teacher-forced three-row batch, chunk size 64; same prompt and source token hash as prior replay.
observation.state: At every one of 24 GDN layers and token t, after the recurrent update and C128 QDQ: ||S_INT8(t)-S_FP(t)||_F/(||S_FP(t)||_F+1e-12). Hadamard state is pulled back using the existing normalized symmetric H128 before subtraction.
observation.readout: At each GDN layer norm forward-pre-hook, inputs[0] is the actual per-token GDN recurrent readout, after the recurrent core but before RMSNorm, gate and out projection. Compare each INT8 row to FP in this unrotated value/output basis: ||r_INT8-r_FP||_2/(||r_FP||_2+1e-12). It is not the lag-one linearized M5 error.
observation.logit: At the output logits of the same teacher-forced forward pass, exact full-vocabulary KL(FP||INT8), FP and INT8 entropy, FP top1 agreement, and both FP and INT8 top1 margins. No logits are serialized.
observation.denominator_audit: Report counts with state/readout FP norm below 1e-8 and all nonfinite values; do not silently drop or winsorize. Existing clean59 exclusion remains symmetric.

parity_gate.source: Reuse passed prior checkpoint and source provenance audits, and independently hash the quantizer source/function and runtime H128 matrix. Require exact frozen token hash/pairing.
parity_gate.new_hook: For the first fixed source trajectory, compare 127 positions against old M5 state m0_relative and persistent replay exact KL/top1; repeat deterministic replay. Maximum absolute state and KL deviation <=1e-5, top1 exact, repeated readout and entropy deviation <=1e-5. Check unquantized FP/Hadamard readout equivalence on the same positions with p95 relative divergence <=0.03.
parity_gate.failure_rule: If any parity check fails, stop before formal comparison and preserve the failure artifact.

fixed_thresholds.margin_collapse: INT8 margin on FP-selected top1 token <=0
fixed_thresholds.top1_mismatch: INT8 top1 token != FP top1 token
fixed_thresholds.rationale: 10% relative distortion and 0.1 nat KL are round, outcome-independent engineering thresholds, not calibrated on rescue labels. Margin/top1 are parameter-free events.

aggregation.layer_to_token: Primary state/readout trajectories use the median across all 24 fixed GDN layers; layer p95 and full per-layer rows are secondary. No layer selection.
aggregation.onset: First t whose metric exceeds its fixed threshold; if never crossed, right-censor at N-1. Report event rate and censored restricted onset, raw and normalized by N-1. For margin/top1 use first event analogously.
aggregation.growth: For positive continuous D at adjacent t, g_log(t)=log(D(t+1)+1e-6)-log(D(t)+1e-6). Primary growth is the mean of g_log in the final third of each trajectory (fractional t in [2/3,1)); also report median, p95, positive-tail p95 and first/middle thirds. The same indices are paired across rotations.
aggregation.instantaneous: Per-trajectory median, p95 and CVaR95 of D, with no outlier removal.
aggregation.comparison: Paired Hadamard minus Identity differences on clean59; lower D/growth and later onset are beneficial. Report medians, trajectory bootstrap 95% CI (5000 resamples, seed 20260924), paired sign proportion and two-sided sign p.

rescue.groups: Rebuild stable_correct, hadamard_rescue, stable_failure from frozen real (problem_id, seed) outcome IDs; do not hard-code members or use labels during replay.
rescue.priority: Hadamard-rescue readout onset and late readout log-growth, then state and logit tiers. Compare rescue improvement to stable-failure using one-sided 10000-permutation test, bootstrap CI and Cliff's delta; stable-correct is a control.
rescue.primary_direction: Rescue has later readout onset (T_H-T_I>0) and lower late readout log-growth (G_H-G_I<0); improvement should be greater than in stable-failure.

mechanism_classification.SUPPORTED: Both primary readout onset and late readout growth improve in rescue: each paired median has bootstrap CI excluding zero in beneficial direction, and each rescue-vs-stable-failure one-sided permutation p<0.05. State and logit results are reported even if discordant; strong opposite state evidence downgrades to PARTIAL.
mechanism_classification.PARTIAL: At least one of the two primary readout tests meets both its paired-bootstrap and rescue-vs-failure conditions, but SUPPORTED is not met, or SUPPORTED readout conditions hold with strong opposite state evidence.
mechanism_classification.NOT_SUPPORTED: All required observations are valid and neither primary readout test meets both conditions, or both primary readout directions are opposite.
mechanism_classification.INCONCLUSIVE: Parity/provenance fails or required readout/onset/growth data cannot be reconstructed without changing semantics.
mechanism_classification.objective_hint: TRAJECTORY_STABILITY_BASED only for SUPPORTED; otherwise NO_STABILITY_EVIDENCE_FOUND. No training follows automatically.

secondary_generation: Only inspect already-frozen AIME output fields for first divergence, repetition or oscillation if present; label supplementary and do not infer teacher-forced causation.
